note: Expanded-roster damage budgets (haven-v409). Each class was measured with tools/skill_balance.js stationary() for 120 s against 1 and 3 targets at Base Lv 99 / 150 / 175 by tier (Ninja and Gunslinger at 150), every skill maxed, and fitted to `target` x its `sibling`. atk = class row attack multiplier, K = SKILL_TUNING single, A = SKILL_TUNING area. haven-v410: Kagerou & Oboro and Rebellion were fitted with tools/fit_expanded_budget.js (same measurement, attack multiplier left as written). haven-v412: every class refitted after the signature-skill and autocast rework; the Monk line has no area skill of its own, so Champion is fitted on one target only. haven-v413: owner targets - about 1.2 x the sibling, 1.05 for the four "close" classes, 1.25 Sorcerer and Shadow Chaser, 1.3 Sura, Geneticist 1.2 on one target and 1.4 (`area`) on three; the attack multiplier of Sura, Shadow Chaser, Maestro & Wanderer and Rebellion was lowered so skills carry more of the budget. Sura: 2.27 x Rune Knight on one target (1.3 x Guillotine Cross, the strongest original fourth job there); its area multiplier sits at the 0.2 floor, giving 1.94 x on three. haven-v414: owner revised the targets down - about 1.1 x the sibling, 1.05 for the four close classes, 1.15 Sorcerer and Shadow Chaser, Geneticist 1.1 / 1.25, Sura 2.07 x Rune Knight (1.17 x Guillotine Cross). `area` records the measured three-target ratio where it differs from `target`.
